name: 1:1 Travel Consultation
tagline: Get a 60-minute video call with Zoe to plan your next trip.
description: A live one-on-one video call with Zoe to map out your next international trip — destinations, budget, safety, logistics, and neighborhood-level recommendations based on Zoe's first-hand travels.
whatsIncluded: Personalized destination shortlist based on your goals and budget
Follow-up summary notes delivered within 24 hours
deliverables: Written summary with links and next steps
nextStepCta: Pay via PayPal, then Zoe will reach out via Crisp within 24 hours to schedule your call.

name: Custom Itinerary
tagline: A fully built day-by-day itinerary for your trip.
description: Zoe designs a complete day-by-day itinerary for your trip, including accommodations, transport, activities, meals, and budget tracking. No call required.
whatsIncluded: Day-by-day schedule with times and transport between each stop
Restaurant shortlist per day with price ranges
deliverables: Google Maps list with all pinned locations
nextStepCta: Pay via PayPal. Zoe will message you on Crisp within 1 business day to collect your trip details.

name: Small Group Trip
tagline: Join Zoe on a curated small group trip.
description: Travel with Zoe and a small group (6-10 people) on a curated multi-day experience. All logistics handled — accommodations, transport, guides, and most meals.
whatsIncluded: Small group (6-10 people) led by Zoe
Accommodations in boutique hotels or villas
Curated activities, guides, and cultural experiences
nextStepCta: Reach out on Crisp first to confirm availability for your desired dates, then pay via PayPal to reserve your spot.

name: Trip Concierge
description: Zoe is on call via Crisp chat for the duration of your trip to answer questions, troubleshoot issues, and make last-minute recommendations.
duration: Up to 14 days of trip support
whatsIncluded: On-demand chat support via Crisp for 14 days
nextStepCta: Pay via PayPal and message Zoe on Crisp to activate your concierge window.
